_how_to_add: Key = the canonical node name in company_metadata.json (a US company). Value = {checked, note, sources: [...]}.
Only documents the UTILITY itself filed or posted: its own website, or a state commission docket filtered to the utility as filer.
Never intervenor testimony, commission-staff data requests, commission orders, or articles.
page   {kind, url, entity?, link_re?, keep_re?, skip_re?: [..]} - a page on the utility's own site that links the PDFs.
Every link matching link_re (default: '.pdf') or whose text says '(PDF)' is a candidate; its link text is the title.
ga_psc {kind, docket, filer, entity?} - a Georgia PSC FACTS docket (psc.ga.gov/search/facts-docket/?docketId=N);
only documents whose filer is exactly `filer` (as the docket page shows it) are candidates.
doc    {kind, url, title, date (YYYY-MM-DD, the filing date), entity?, listed_at?} - one document, taken once whatever its date.
Titles are filtered by utility_filings.py NOISE (skipped) and KEEP (must match); keep_re replaces KEEP, skip_re adds skips.
`entity` = the operating subsidiary that filed (Georgia Power, FPL ...); it starts the label's short title.
Check a new source with: python -X utf8 utility_filings.py sync --company "<Company>" (then `status --company`) and read the skip reasons.
Another state's docket system needs its own list function in utility_filings.py (see list_ga_psc); a docket site behind a bot
challenge or a login (Ohio PUCO DIS, checked 2026-10-01) cannot be used - take the utility's own copy of the document instead.
Xcel Energy (checked 2026-10-01): its resource-plan pages now link Salesforce content-delivery pages (xcelnew.my.salesforce.com/sfc/p/...)
that only render through JavaScript - no direct PDF, so Xcel is not seeded; its Minnesota / Colorado dockets need their own list functions.

Dominion Energy.note: Dominion's IRP page links the Virginia IRP (2024) and its annual update (filed with the Virginia SCC, Case PUR-2025-00184, 10-15-2025) plus the South Carolina IRP. Data-center load is the core of the Virginia plan.

sources.title: Dominion Energy Virginia 2025 Integrated Resource Plan Update

Southern Company.note: Georgia Power files a quarterly Large Load Economic Development Report (contracted / pipeline large load, mostly data centers) in Georgia PSC docket 55378, and its 2025 IRP plus the DCO-1 / LCOR-1 data-center tariffs in docket 56002. The IRP page holds the one-page summary.

American Electric Power.note: Indiana Michigan Power's IRP page (2024 Indiana IRP filed with the IURC 03-28-2025; I&M's data-center load in Fort Wayne / New Carlisle). AEP Ohio's data-center tariff case (PUCO 24-0508-EL-ATA) sits behind a bot challenge and is not read.

Entergy.note: Entergy Louisiana's 2027 IRP cycle page (data assumptions incl. the load forecast) and its regulatory page (generation and transmission applications, e.g. the power stations for large industrial / data-center load).

NextEra Energy.note: FPL's 2026-2035 Ten Year Power Plant Site Plan (filed with the Florida PSC 04-01-2026, Docket 20260000-OT; large-load customers under LLCS-1 / LLCS-2), posted on NextEra's IR site. 1,070 pages / 44 MB.

sources.title: FPL 2026-2035 Ten Year Power Plant Site Plan
